Name: Large Farm
Author: Zinnalynn
Description:
[size=3]This is a large, simple farm. Not a lot of water, but the fishing is better than on a normal farm. Forage items can appear. It has a mine cart in a quarry. There is a path that leads to a special Hot Spring, accessible once you've upgraded some tools. [/size]

[size=5]♥ This adds a NEW farm type, for a new save. It does not replace any farms. ♥[/size]

Downloads.Description: fixed maps not changing with the seasons, and made it so you can enter farm from bus stop while mounted.

Manifest.Name: Large Farm!
Manifest.Description: A Larger farm. Lots of space to plant things. More Space for more friends!
